────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Reason step by step about which three prime numbers below 20 sum to 31, then create a file named out.txt in the current directory listing them one per line, then reply DONE.

  To find three prime numbers below 20 that sum to 31:

  1. List all prime numbers below 20:
  2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19.
  2. Check parity:
  The target sum is 31, which is odd. The sum of three integers can only be odd if:
      • All three are odd, or
      • Two are even and one is odd.
  Since the only even prime is 2, we cannot have two distinct even primes (and even with repetition, 2 + 2 + p = 31 ⟹ p = 27, which is not prime).
  Therefore, all three primes must be odd primes chosen from {3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19}.
  3. Find combination(s) of three distinct odd primes summing to 31:
      • If the largest prime is 19:
      31 - 19 = 12. Two odd primes summing to 12:
	  • 5 + 7 = 12 ⟹ {5, 7, 19} (5 + 7 + 19 = 31).
      • If the largest prime is 17:
      31 - 17 = 14. Two odd primes summing to 14:
	  • 3 + 11 = 14 ⟹ {3, 11, 17} (3 + 11 + 17 = 31).
	  • 7 + 7 = 14 (not distinct).
      • If the largest prime is 13:
      31 - 13 = 18. Two odd primes below 13 summing to 18:
	  • 5 + 13 = 18 (repeat 13)
	  • 7 + 11 = 18 ⟹ {7, 11, 13} (7 + 11 + 13 = 31).



  Any valid set works, such as 5, 7, 19 (or 3, 11, 17 or 7, 11, 13). We will use:

  • 5
  • 7
  • 19

  Now, creating out.txt with these three prime numbers.
